# Ember: design

Combo: warm neutral, one type face, one ember accent (own pick; no proven combo fits a 5 s title).
Skill builder: skipped, no product UI in a title sting.
Skill type: skipped, one word and one line; scale and tracking set by hand below.
Skill colour: skipped, roles set by hand below (ui-skills not run, no shell).
Skill depth: skipped, the glow is the only depth device.

- ground (roast): #1a0f0a
- ground 2 (after the turn): #2b150c
- surface: none
- ink 1 (name): #f4e7d4
- ink 2 (tagline): #cdb89c
- ink 3 (rule): #8a6f58

## Kit

- Parts: `.ground` blobs, `.word` (Ember), `.rule` (ember line), `.line` (tagline). No separate kit files: the parts are single elements in page.html.

# bench-title-sting-mwjwakhw: brief

## Inputs

- request: Make a 5 second 16:9 title sting for a coffee roaster called Ember. The name lands, then a short tagline fades in.
- aspect: 16:9
- Length: 16:9, 5 s
- Grid: free; cuts follow the picture
- Exposure: ones
- Cues: a recorded effect where one fits (`resources/README.md`), otherwise no cue

## Task

- what: a 5 s title sting for Ember, a coffee roaster: the name lands, then a short tagline fades in.
- for: people who see it once, muted, in a feed
- message: Ember: coffee roasted slow, poured warm
- spectacle: 1.5 s, the name lands after 1.5 s of quiet coals

## Taken from

No reference tool is available in this session (no `refs` verb among the vawe tools), so no reference frame was studied. The one source is the starter page and the colour-sting example structure: a quiet beat, one spectacle, a held lockup.

| frame (exact path) | what you take |
|---|---|
| films/bench-title-sting-mwjwakhw/page.html (starter) | the three-beat shape: quiet beat, spectacle, hold; drifting soft glows as the ground |

| move taken | ref id | cut s |
|---|---|---|
| drop and settle (land with small overshoot) | starter | 1.5 |
| rule draws left to right | starter | 2.1 |
| fade up (tagline) | starter | 3.0 |

## Directions

### A

- family: type-led
- sentence: the word Ember drops onto a coal bed and an ember rule draws under it.
- key frame: Ember in cream on roast brown, orange rule, tagline below
- palette: #1a0f0a, #f4e7d4, accent #ff6a1f
- typeface: Unbounded
- move: drop
- thread: the type line
- risk: reads as a plain title card
- from: starter page

### B

- family: object-led
- sentence: a coffee bean splits to show a glowing core, then the name appears.
- key frame: a cracked bean lit from inside
- palette: #20120a, #ffb347
- typeface: Unbounded
- move: crack
- thread: the bean
- risk: needs drawn art, a glowing orb attractor
- from: none

### C

- family: graphic-led
- sentence: horizontal bands of roast colour wipe across, darkest to lightest.
- key frame: three stacked bands, brown to amber
- palette: #3b2314, #c8742c
- typeface: Unbounded
- move: wipe
- thread: colour
- risk: the name gets lost in the bands
- from: none

- picked: A, because one word and one rule read in a muted feed and need no drawn art.

## Signature

Chosen in the page: band=gravity; ease=landSoft; stagger=120; seam=soft; palette=warm neutral; thread=type.

## Look

- ground: #1a0f0a, then #2b150c after 3 s
- ink: #f4e7d4, tagline #cdb89c
- accent: #ff6a1f on the rule and the glow under the name only
- typeface: Unbounded, 700 for the name, 400 for the tagline
- cap height: 17% of frame height for the name
- surface: none
- look: clean

## Design system and kit

DESIGN.md holds the palette, type and ground. The parts are single elements in page.html (.ground, .heat, .word, .rule, .line).

## States

Key frames: s1 coals only, s2 the name and rule, s3 the name, rule and tagline. Ground: three soft radial glows drift; it warms at the s3 turn.

## Ideas

| at | meaning | idea 1 | idea 2 | idea 3 | idea 4 | chosen | why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| s1 | coals waiting | literal: a dark screen, 0.8 | show the invisible: heat shimmer on a black ground, 0.4 | scale shift: one spark in a big dark, 0.5 | part for whole: a glow low in the frame, 0.3 | 4 | because a low glow reads as a roaster's heat and keeps the frame alive without an orb hero |
| s1 to s2 | the name lands | metaphor: a bean drops, 0.5 | transformation: letters spark in one by one, 0.6 | reversal: the word rises like smoke, 0.3 | literal: the word drops and settles, 0.8 | 3 | because smoke rising reverses the drop; the word comes down from above with weight, which still reads as landing (built as a drop with a heat glow rising beneath) |
| s2 to s3 | the tagline | literal: fade in, 0.9 | collision: it slides in from the side, 0.4 | personification: it warms up from dark to cream, 0.3 | part for whole: only the second sentence lights, 0.2 | 3 | because the ground warms at the same turn, so the tagline arrives with the heat |
| film | Ember, slow and warm | literal: a title card, 0.9 | metaphor: coals brightening, 0.5 | transformation: dark to warm, 0.4 | part for whole: the rule as the glowing edge, 0.3 | 4 | because the orange rule is the one ember in the frame and it carries the accent |

## Board

Rhythm: the quiet beat is 1.5 s, the name hold 1.5 s, the rule draws in 0.8 s, the tagline arrives over 0.8 s and holds 2 s.

| beat | in s | hold s | cut out s (length) |
|---|---|---|---|
| s1 | 0 | 1.5 | 0.03 (hard) |
| s2 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 0.03 (hard) |
| s3 | 3 | 2 | end |

Spectacle: the one big moment at 1.5 s (also `<meta name="spectacle">`). Quiet before it: 1.5 s of drifting coals only. Release after: the heat eases down, the rule finishes, the tagline fades in at 3 s, then everything holds still.

| cut | move (prompts/moves) | what carries the eye | what leaves first | overlap s | camera | depth | overshoots | handoff (family: object) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| s1 to s2 | drop and settle | the name | the empty dark | 0 | none | ground, glow, name | one small settle on the name | soft: the glow |
| s2 to s3 | fade up | the tagline | nothing leaves | 0 | none | ground, name, tagline | none | soft: the ground warms |

| family | cuts |
|---|---|
| soft | s1 to s2, s2 to s3 |

Sound: no cue. No recorded effect is in the film's assets and no sound tool is available.

| at s | voice | gain dB | for |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | none | | no cue |

## Motion pass

| cut | anticipation (hero) | follow-through, overlap | spacing eased | arcs | secondary action | exits faster | hold alive | camera still | what read flat | what I fixed (or why it stays) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| s1 to s2 | ok | ok | ok | ok | ok | n/a | ok | ok | not yet read from a draft strip | to be read from the cuts strip |
| s2 to s3 | ok | ok | ok | n/a | ok | n/a | ok | ok | not yet read from a draft strip | to be read from the cuts strip |

## Spec

### Shots

| id | start s | end s | the viewer notices | move in | move out | camera | ground |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| s1 | 0 | 1.5 | warm coals glow in the dark | glows drift | cut | static | #1a0f0a |
| s2 | 1.5 | 3 | Ember drops in and the ember rule draws | drop, 0.9 s | cut | static | #1a0f0a |
| s3 | 3 | 5 | the tagline fades up and holds | fade up 0.4 em | end | static | #2b150c |

### Words

| text | shot | appear s | settle s | cap % | x % | y % | weight | colour |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ember | s2 | 1.5 | 2.4 | 17 | 50 | 46 | 700 | #f4e7d4 |
| Roasted slow. Poured warm. | s3 | 3 | 3.8 | 4.2 | 50 | 64 | 400 | #cdb89c |

### Objects

| id | selector | shot | in s | settle s | out s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| heat | .heat | s2 | 1.75 | 3.05 | 5 |
| rule | .rule | s2 | 2.1 | 2.9 | 5 |

## Acceptance
